smoke.verdict: PASS (1 commit, SMOKE OK 3/3, tree clean after cleanup)
smoke.notes: The offline mode exists: --selftest spawns a demo repo in .selftest/ (git init + first commit, no network), runs its smoke.mjs (3/3 green), then removes everything — `git status --porcelain` back to 0 lines. The NETWORKED path (pushing spawned repos to GitHub) was NOT exercised — out of scope for this lane's no-network rule. Repo itself is the fleet's memory hub (lode ledgers, FLEET.md map, tavern rounds, witness rollups) — studied read-only.

essence: the seedbox: seed.md -> rigor-at-birth repo whose first commit is charter law

ideas.name: Seed -> repo -> receipted experiment
ideas.statement: A question is cheapest to answer at the moment it is asked: one seed markdown dropped into the hopper germinates a fully-scaffolded repo in one deterministic step — charter embedded VERBATIM as the first commit (the question is the first receipt), so rigor never depends on the mood of whoever is planting.

ideas.name: Rigor at birth, not retrofit
ideas.statement: Every spawned repo is born with CI that runs a REAL smoke on every push (the check count in the final line is the contract CI enforces) plus the house doctrine block — paired arms, decision rules before the run, counterfactual measurement, honest negatives, replayable smoke — so no fleet repo ever becomes 'a script with no receipt'.

ideas.name: Fleet memory institutions
ideas.statement: Beyond the seedbox, the repo keeps the fleet's append-only memory: the lode six-stage discovery loop (scout/extract/score/register/lane/fold — a mine becomes an experiment only when its falsifiable prediction is sealed), the Tap Tavern where every round is sealed with stone-v1, and registry.jsonl recording every pre-registered prediction set and its verdict.

ideas.name: Cross-chain evidence machinery
ideas.statement: The evidence layer reaches across chains: FLEET.md regenerates the 17-repo/27-edge quilt fold map, the wave-46 witness-roller walks EVERY chain the fleet owns and parents them into ONE witness chain verified by the UNMODIFIED wave-44 module, and the wave-45 tool battery audits byte-by-byte truncate resistance — all zero-dep, node:crypto only, offline only.

parts.name: seed intake (the hopper mouth)
parts.essence: seed markdown files (14 in seeds/, from seed1 to seed-story, including the seed-grok2 charter that spawned exoj) are the sole input format: a question written down before any repo exists.
parts.gate: spawn refuses an existing slug directory ('already exists — pick another slug')
parts.failure_mode: overwriting an existing lane would destroy a charter of record

parts.name: charter injection (seed verbatim)
parts.essence: the CHARTER template wraps the seed unmodified under a fixed header: 'The seed below is the charter of record — it is versioned in this repo's first commit and never edited afterward. Every experiment here must carry its decision rules as receipts dated BEFORE the run.'
parts.gate: seed text embedded verbatim (seed.trim() + newline only) — no editorial rewrite
parts.failure_mode: a paraphrased charter would let the spawn drift from the asked question

parts.name: house doctrine block
parts.essence: every spawn inherits five non-optional laws verbatim: paired arms identical worlds; decision rules before the run; counterfactual measurement; honest negatives fail loudly; replayable smoke on every commit.
outputs: doctrine section in every spawned README
parts.gate: all five laws present in the template (structural: template constant)
parts.failure_mode: a spawn without the doctrine block would repeat the pre-seedbox era of unreceipted scripts

parts.name: CI workflow at birth
parts.essence: each spawn gets .github/workflows/smoke.yml: node 22, `node smoke.mjs` on push and workflow_dispatch — the repo proves itself before any feature code exists.
parts.failure_mode: a repo whose CI arrives late inherits undocumented breakage

parts.name: smoke contract (count is the contract)
parts.essence: smoke.mjs template ships three real checks (sha256 of empty string KAT, randomBytes entropy, charter present), prints per-check marks, and the final 'SMOKE OK (n/n checks)' line with exit code is the contract CI enforces.
parts.gate: exit 0 iff fail === 0; the printed count is the CI-enforced contract
parts.failure_mode: a stub smoke with no real check would costume rigor

parts.name: deterministic scaffold + first commit
parts.essence: spawn() writes README/package.json/CI/smoke/.gitignore/outputs/ then git init + add + commit 'seed: charter committed verbatim — the question is the first receipt' — the first commit is law, before any experiment code.
parts.gate: commit message fixed; commit exists before the lane ever runs
parts.failure_mode: a spawn whose charter commit comes after experiments has no law to appeal to

parts.name: selftest loop (offline dog-food)
parts.essence: --selftest writes a demo seed, spawns .selftest/, runs its smoke via execSync, prints commit count + 'smoke green -> PASS/FAIL', then removes both artifacts — the seedbox verifies its own germination.
parts.gate: PASS iff demo repo has 1 commit AND its smoke output includes 'SMOKE OK'; tree left clean (rmSync of dir + seed)
parts.failure_mode: a seedbox that could not prove its own spawn would be untrusted scaffolding

parts.name: dispatch contract
parts.essence: argv dispatch: '--selftest' runs the loop; '<seed> <slug>' spawns; anything else prints usage and exits 1.
parts.gate: wrong arity -> usage line + exit 1 (never a half-spawn)
parts.failure_mode: a partial spawn on bad args would litter half-scaffolded repos

parts.name: seed-to-charter identity (exoj lineage)
parts.essence: seeds/seed-grok2.md ('Category-theoretic investigation of the inverted field') appears VERBATIM as the charter in exoj's README — the living proof that spawned repos keep their seed as law, and the direct ancestor link in this decomposition lane (exoj is studied next to it in garden).
parts.gate: charter text in the spawned repo == seed text byte-for-byte (verbatim claim checked by reading both)
parts.failure_mode: a diverged charter would break the chain of custody from question to verdict

parts.name: FLEET.md quilt fold map
parts.essence: the fleet map as mermaid graph — '17 repos, 27 edges. Regenerated by quilt-links.mjs --graph' — with typed edges (grown-on, consumes, related), the structural evidence of who leans on whom.
parts.gate: regenerable by tool, not hand-maintained prose
parts.failure_mode: a hand-edited map would drift from the repos it claims to describe

parts.name: lode six-stage discovery loop
parts.essence: scout -> extract -> score -> register -> lane -> fold, each with a law: no claim without a raw receipt file; Elo-scored mines with written reasons; a mine becomes an experiment ONLY when its falsifiable prediction is sealed (sha256 of exact prediction text in mines.jsonl) and the target lane's registration cites the mine id.
parts.gate: registration requires the sealed prediction hash + mine-id citation (admission into the fleet experiment queue)
parts.failure_mode: an unsealed 'prediction' would be a post-hoc bet, not a falsifiable one

parts.name: lode fail-closed validation
parts.essence: lode_validate.mjs enforces schema + hash + append-only on the ledgers, exit 2 on violation, with tamper self-tests; pre-* snapshot files (registry.jsonl.pre-a13, mines.jsonl.pre-m13 ...) preserve ledger history at each append.
parts.gate: append-only enforced fail-closed (exit 2); tamper self-tests included
parts.failure_mode: a rewritten ledger would erase what the fleet predicted and what happened

parts.name: Tap Tavern (sealed discourse)
parts.essence: 'Not a chat room — a ledger': every round is sealed with the Stone (stone-v1 forward format), every voice speaks only from receipted artifacts, every claim carries refs a verifier can check; predictions/answers/ledger per round (round-11, round-12, ...).
parts.gate: every claim carries verifier-checkable refs (house rules header)
parts.failure_mode: unsealed rounds would let the fleet argue from memory instead of record

parts.name: cross-chain witness rollup (46-e)
parts.essence: rollup.mjs walks EVERY chain the fleet owns (remote chains fetched at pinned commit shas labeled LIVE; local files labeled FIXTURE), emits one witness receipt per chain using the wave-44 grammar, parents them into ONE wave-46 witness chain, then verifies that chain with the UNMODIFIED wave-44 module in-process AND via its CLI.
outputs: one parented witness chain + per-chain receipts
parts.gate: exit 0 IFF every target verified AND the wave-46 chain verifies (with the unmodified verifier — no verifier drift allowed)
parts.failure_mode: verifying with a patched verifier would let the rollup bless its own output

parts.name: tool verification battery (wave 45)
parts.essence: zero-dependency, node:crypto-only, offline-only tools: verify-fleet.mjs (kept untouched, additive imports only), truncate-audit.mjs (tests EVERY byte offset 0..len-1 of every chain for truncate resistance), moth-seal, wal-conformance — each with its own .test.mjs.
parts.gate: all artifacts offline only, zero deps, no keys (WAVE45 header law); truncate audit is exhaustive per byte offset
parts.failure_mode: a networked or keyed tool would not be runnable by any stranger at audit time

parts.name: registry of predictions (fleet memory)
parts.essence: registry.jsonl rows: {set_id, repo, commit, predictions, verdict, verdict_commit, registration_ref, ts} — every pre-registered prediction set across the repos, its verdict commit and status; append-only, sampled rows show JEPA-R4/R5 PASS with seal refs.
parts.gate: append-only (enforced by P12's validator); each row cites its registration seal
parts.failure_mode: editing a verdict row would rewrite the fleet's memory of its own bets

cells.expr: seeds/*.md -> seedbox hopper (14 charters of record on disk)
README(spawn) = HEADER + seed.verbatim + DOCTRINE(5 laws) + first-lane checklist
spawn(seed, slug): scaffold 6 files -> git init -> commit 'charter verbatim' (1 commit)
on push: node smoke.mjs -> 'SMOKE OK (n/n)' + exit code
--selftest: spawn demo -> smoke green? -> cleanup -> PASS + clean tree
scout -> extract -> score -> register(sealed prediction + mine id) -> lane -> fold
lode_validate: schema + hash + append-only, exit 2 fail-closed, tamper self-tests
registry.jsonl: {set_id, repo, commit, verdict, seal ref, ts} append-only
round: predictions -> answers -> stone-v1 sealed ledger + refs
witness-roller: ALL fleet chains -> one parented witness chain verified by unmodified wave-44

layer_logic.0: substrate is the seed document itself: a question written before any code exists, plus the fleet's shared hash-chain formats (fnv1a-64, stone-v1, wave-44 witness grammar) it references
layer_logic.1: one deterministic transform: spawn() turns seed+slug into a six-file scaffold whose first commit already carries the law — no generation step is left to judgment
layer_logic.2: policy is the doctrine block: paired arms, decision rules before the run, counterfactual measurement, honest negatives, replayable smoke — injected into every repo, plus lode's admission law (sealed falsifiable prediction or no experiment)
layer_logic.3: interfaces: the hopper (seeds/), the dispatch contract, CI-on-push, the Tap Tavern's sealed rounds, and the witness rollup's LIVE-vs-FIXTURE labeling
layer_logic.4: evidence: the SMOKE OK count contract, the selftest that leaves a clean tree, fail-closed lode validation with pre-* snapshots, the append-only registry of every prediction and verdict, and byte-offset-exhaustive truncate audits
